vectors.name: list-intervening-column
vectors.description: A separator between an item's marker column and its definition list column folds into the term as text.

vectors.name: outer-marker-column
vectors.description: A description separator at the item's own marker column ends the item and becomes a document paragraph.

vectors.name: double-colon
vectors.description: A term marker past the column the item closed at opens a new list there (carve#3885); block-opener-overindented reports it (carve#3992).

vectors.name: double-colon-outer-column
vectors.description: A term marker at the item's own marker column opens a new definition list at that level.

vectors.name: open-description
vectors.description: Below the list column, a separator folds into an open description paragraph (markup-carve/carve#3451).

vectors.name: quoted-list
vectors.description: A quote prefix does not erase the nested list's authored column.

vectors.name: quoted-outer-column
vectors.description: At the quoted item's marker column the separator becomes a quoted paragraph.

vectors.name: after-blank
vectors.description: After a blank line, a below-column separator is a separate paragraph, not a loose description.

vectors.name: nested-item
vectors.description: The innermost item's definition list supplies the target column.

vectors.name: nested-item-outer-content-column
vectors.description: At the inner item's marker column the separator is text in the outer item.

vectors.name: at-list-column
vectors.description: A separator at the definition list column adds a description.

vectors.name: within-description
vectors.description: An indented separator opens a nested definition list inside a description.

vectors.name: attaches-to-outer-list
vectors.description: A separator that attaches to a surviving outer definition list is structural.

vectors.name: escaped-separator
vectors.description: An escaped colon is literal text.

vectors.name: code-payload
vectors.description: A separator-shaped code line is payload, not a separator.

vectors.name: outside-container
vectors.description: A top-level definition list has no displaced nested list.

vectors.name: correct-document
vectors.description: Nested definition lists in items and quotes, every separator at its list column.
